//: Copy-paste detector for the game source. Run with: npm run duplication
//thresholds: min-tokens 60 is deliberately above jscpd's default of 50. At 50 the report
fills up with repeated data literals inside config/registries/*.js — the
same six-line stat block written out per enemy/item. That is content, not
spaghetti, and it buries the real findings. 60 drops it and keeps every
min-lines 5 keeps out one-line idiom repeats.
JSX legitimately repeats: two components that look similar are not
duplication. The token threshold is what filters that, not an exclusion.
